asked: # Build: bugs-board (Current profile) - confirmed bugs list plugin ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) "Do we have a confirmed bugs list?" -> "Yep, and I want to be able to drag and drop and arrange them. And show which builds they're part of. And if they're part of a build that's being run, and what line it is in the queue. And all that good stuff. I want to be able to move it from one build to another one." ... "I need an auto-optimize switch, which will move the bugs to appropriate builds that are either in queue or in process." Book to a free named agent (Polo if his card exists, else Reel Rhonda). Register id `bugs-board` in the `current` profile + banner entry + What Brett said block. Steps through the store. ## Do - s1 **Bugs plugin** (console, lazy-loadable): `bug@1` records stored with the builds store (synced to main via orch-live-sync like builds): title, details, status (confirmed / in build / fixed / won't fix), severity, app/area, reported by + when, verbatim 'What Brett said', linked build id, fixed-in PR. Exposed via REST + MCP + CLI (bugs_list, bug_add, bug_update, bug_move {bug, build}, bug_reorder, bugs_optimize) so Amber, agents and Brett all add/tick bugs. - s2 **Board UI**: list + grouped views; **drag and drop to reorder** (priority) and **drag a bug onto a build** (or between builds) to move it; each row shows its **build** chip with live state: running (agent avatar, step x/y), queued (**position in the slot queue**, from agent-slots), paused, built/awaiting merge (PR #), merged; unassigned bugs in their own group. Context menu: Move to build..., New build from bug(s), Open build, Mark fixed, Edit. Multi-select. Filter by profile filter (profile-switcher) / app / status. Banner count of open bugs. - s3 **Moving a bug into a build** appends it to that build's brief as an addendum (and to a running session via tmux send-keys, like Amber does), and adds a step to the build in the store; removing reverses it. Fixed when the build's PR merges -> bug auto-marked fixed with the PR link. - s4 **Auto-optimize switch** (on the board header + Bugs settings, default off): zero-token rules first - match each unassigned/confirmed bug to the best **queued or running** build by app/area/plugin/files (bug area tags vs the build's brief and touched files), prefer builds already touching those files, never into a finished/merging build, never more than N bugs per build (setting); shows a preview of proposed moves with Apply / Undo; when on, re-runs on new bugs and when the queue changes. Optional 'Ask AI' button for unclear matches (costs tokens, off by default). - s5 **Seed** with today's confirmed bugs: (1) build rows don't open + step actions dead -> hotfix-build-manager; (2) running count wrong/stale statuses -> hotfix-build-manager; (3) Terminal jumps to front on new sessions + tooltips/tap-to-confirm -> terminal-no-focus; (4) console embedded in Molly doesn't receive commands -> land-round-2 (#288); (5) windows don't remember their size on reopen -> unassigned; (6) Terminal 'Opens in' description wording wrong ('Where Open a tab opens') -> unassigned; (7) banners all turn one colour on some themes -> app-style-override (banner tokens); (8) GitHub token rate-limited (shared PAT) -> unassigned, needs Brett to finish GitHub App auth. - Tests/type-check, phone + desktop screenshot filed to UI Review (non-blocking), PR -> merges when CI green, redeploy console. Never leave tsc/vite/playwright running. Report `_claude/builds/reports/bugs-board.md`. Commits clean and professional. ## ADDENDUM 1 (Brett, voice) - group chat handoffs Brett: "Anytime a bug is moved to a different build, put in the group chat whatever agent is assigned. Be like, yo, I'm sending it over. And they gotta be like, all right, or yo, I don't have time for that shit right now, send it to somebody else. Then it'll pop up, or it will automatically send it to somebody else: yo, can you handle it, G? Yeah, I got you, dog." - Every bug move …
